author: Kevin Wang (KevinChunye)
method: C++20 PathFinder negotiation (slow, fanout-weighted present costs, A* for single-sink nets) + exact per-net shortest-path-tree reroute with random equal-delay ties + large-neighbourhood search with negotiated group repair, threshold acceptance from 32 cooling linearly to 0, kicks and return to best, move type chosen by a discounted Thompson-sampling bandit; 4 threads adopting the best every fifth of the run; time limit per case proportional to net count; from scratch
time_limit_policy: 28,800 s per tier split in proportion to net count: limit(case) = 28800 x nets(case) / 988 (case_01 4838.9 s, case_02 6675.3 s, case_03 8482.6 s, case_04 8803.2 s)
